About Us

Driven by Vision.
Built on Trust.

Beryos Chemicals LLP — a Gujarat-based manufacturer of high-purity inorganic salts, built by three founders who believe that quality chemistry powers a better world.

Our Story & Origin
Where We Come From

Beryos Chemicals LLP was founded in Gujarat, India — a state synonymous with industrial excellence and entrepreneurial spirit. Three directors with a shared vision established Beryos to fill a clear market gap: a supplier that combines laboratory-grade purity with reliable, large-scale production.

From a focused operation producing core inorganic salts, we have grown into a trusted brand serving clients across India and beyond. Every decision we make is guided by one principle — never compromise on purity.

What We Do & What We Produce
Our Areas of Impact
  • Agriculture — High-purity fertilizer-grade salts that improve crop yield, correct soil deficiencies, and support precision farming including drip irrigation and greenhouse systems.
  • Industry — Salts for chemical synthesis, metal treatment, glass manufacturing, and heat transfer — where purity is a production requirement, not a preference.
  • Sustainable Manufacturing — Processes designed to minimise waste, optimise energy use, and ensure responsible production at every stage.

We produce: Potassium Nitrate · Sodium Nitrate · Sodium Nitrite · Zinc Sulphate · Copper Sulphate · Magnesium Sulphate

Our Goals

02
Reliable Supply — Consistent availability and on-time delivery for every client, every time.
03
Sustainable Growth — Expanding our product range while keeping our environmental footprint minimal.
04
Client Trust — Long-term relationships built on transparency, quality, and exceptional service.
Our Mission

We operate with a long-term view — building a company that is as clean in its practices as it is in its products.

Sustainability

Responsible
Chemistry.

Sustainability at Beryos is not a policy — it is how we work. Built into every process, every sourcing decision, and every product we ship.

Our Commitment

As a chemical manufacturer, we carry a deep responsibility — to our clients, to the communities around our facility, and to the natural environment. We continuously review our manufacturing methods, energy consumption, and waste outputs to reduce our environmental footprint.

We operate in full compliance with all applicable environmental and safety regulations and actively support the local communities where we operate.

Our goal is to be a chemical manufacturer that future generations can be proud of — made in India, responsibly.
Our Practices
  • 01
    Responsible Sourcing — Raw materials only from verified suppliers who meet our environmental and quality standards.
  • 02
    Waste Minimisation — Processes engineered to reduce by-product waste and maximise material efficiency throughout production.
  • 03
    Energy Efficiency — Continuous investment in energy-efficient equipment to reduce our carbon footprint without compromising quality.
  • 04
    Agriculture-First Products — High-purity formulations that require less product per hectare, reducing chemical load on soil and water.
  • 05
    Safe Packaging — Properly labelled, environmentally conscious packaging for safe storage, handling, and transport.
  • 06
    Community & Compliance — Full compliance with all regulations and active support for the communities around our manufacturing facility.

Have a question about our sustainability practices, sourcing standards, or environmental commitments? We'd love to hear from you.

KNO₃
Product Detail

Potassium Nitrate

A premium chloride-free source of potassium and nitrogen, trusted across agriculture and industry worldwide.

Technical Specifications
Appearance White crystalline powder or granules
Color White
Odour Odourless
pH 6.0 – 7.5 (5% solution)
Solubility 31.6 g / 100 mL at 20°C (highly soluble)
Purity ≥ 99.0%
Melting Point 334°C (633°F)
Decomposition 400°C (decomposes to KNO₂ + O₂)
Molar Weight 101.10 g/mol
Particle Size Fine powder to granular
Key Uses
  • Provides potassium and nitrogen to crops simultaneously
  • Chloride-free — safe for chloride-sensitive crops
  • Improves fruit quality, shelf life and root development
  • Acts as oxidising agent in industrial processes
  • Oxidiser in firecrackers & pyrotechnic compositions
  • Binding & oxidising agent in agarbatti (incense sticks)
Industries Served
Agriculture & horticulture (fertigation, foliar spray)
Glass & ceramics manufacturing
Food preservation (E252)
Heat transfer fluids in solar power plants
Pyrotechnics & fireworks
Pharmaceutical & chemical synthesis
NaNO₃
Product Detail

Sodium Nitrate

A fast-acting nitrogen source and versatile industrial oxidiser, produced at high purity for agricultural and industrial applications.

Technical Specifications
Appearance White crystalline powder
Color White
Odour Odourless
pH 6.5 – 8.0 (5% solution)
Solubility 87.6 g / 100 mL at 20°C (highly soluble)
Purity ≥ 99.0%
Melting Point 308°C (586°F)
Decomposition 380°C (forms NaNO₂ + O₂)
Molar Weight 84.99 g/mol
Particle Size Fine to medium crystalline
Key Uses
  • Quick-release nitrogen source for crops
  • Used in mixed salt heat transfer systems for solar energy
  • Acts as flux in glass and ceramic production
  • Key raw material in nitric acid and chemical processes
Industries Served
Agriculture (soil & foliar fertilizer)
Glass, enamel & ceramics
Food preservation (E251)
Heat transfer salt mixtures
Chemical synthesis & oxidising agent
Metal treatment
NaNO₂
Product Detail

Sodium Nitrite

An essential industrial chemical known for its corrosion-inhibiting properties and role as a versatile chemical intermediate.

Technical Specifications
Appearance White to slightly yellowish crystalline powder
Color White / Pale yellow
Odour Slight characteristic odour
pH 9.0 – 11.0 (5% solution)
Solubility 82.0 g / 100 mL at 20°C (highly soluble)
Purity ≥ 98.0%
Melting Point 271°C (520°F)
Decomposition 320°C (decomposes to Na₂O, NO₂, N₂)
Molar Weight 69.00 g/mol
Particle Size Fine crystalline powder
Key Uses
  • Inhibits corrosion in cooling systems and steam boilers
  • Used in production of azo dyes and organic pigments
  • Acts as accelerator in rubber vulcanisation
  • Key intermediate in pharmaceutical synthesis
Industries Served
Metal treatment & corrosion inhibition
Dye & pigment manufacturing
Rubber & polymer industry
Pharmaceutical intermediates
Food preservation (E250)
Construction (concrete additive)
ZnSO₄·7H₂O
Product Detail

Zinc Sulphate

The most widely used zinc micronutrient supplement, essential for correcting zinc deficiency in soils and supporting industrial processes.

Technical Specifications
Chemical Formula ZnSO₄·7H₂O
Appearance White Granules or Crystals (Heptahydrate)
Color White
Odour Odourless
pH (1% aqueous) 5.0 – 6.0
Solubility Highly Soluble in Water
Purity ≥ 98.0%
Melting Point 100°C (loses water of crystallisation)
Decomposition 740°C (anhydrous form decomposes to ZnO + SO₃)
Molar Weight 287.54 g/mol (heptahydrate)
Particle Size Fine powder to granular
Key Uses
  • Corrects zinc deficiency in crops — improves photosynthesis and yield
  • Used in foliar spray and fertigation systems
  • Essential trace element in animal and poultry feed
  • Precipitant in rayon fibre production
Industries Served
Agriculture (micronutrient fertilizer)
Animal feed supplement
Rayon & textile manufacturing
Water treatment & purification
Electroplating & galvanising
Pharmaceutical & cosmetics
CuSO₄·5H₂O
Product Detail

Copper Sulphate

Recognised by its vivid blue crystals, Copper Sulphate is a powerful fungicide, algicide and industrial chemical trusted across sectors.

Technical Specifications
Appearance Vivid blue crystalline granules (pentahydrate)
Color Brilliant blue
Odour Odourless
pH 3.5 – 4.5 (1% solution)
Solubility 20.3 g / 100 mL at 20°C (readily soluble)
Purity ≥ 98.0%
Melting Point 110°C (pentahydrate loses water); anhydrous: 200°C
Decomposition 650°C (forms CuO + SO₃)
Molar Weight 249.69 g/mol (pentahydrate); 159.61 g/mol (anhydrous)
Particle Size Coarse to fine crystals
Key Uses
  • Active ingredient in Bordeaux mixture for crop disease control
  • Controls algae in reservoirs, pools and irrigation systems
  • Used as cathode deposit in copper electroplating
  • Micronutrient supplement in animal feed (regulated levels)
Industries Served
Agriculture (fungicide & algicide)
Electroplating & copper refining
Mining & flotation processes
Swimming pool & water treatment
Animal feed (micronutrient)
Textile & leather industry
MgSO₄·7H₂O
Product Detail

Magnesium Sulphate

Commonly known as Epsom salt. A secondary macronutrient vital for chlorophyll synthesis, enzyme activation and a wide range of industrial uses.

Technical Specifications
Appearance White crystalline powder or flakes (heptahydrate / Epsom salt)
Color White
Odour Odourless
pH 5.5 – 7.0 (5% solution)
Solubility 35.1 g / 100 mL at 20°C (freely soluble)
Purity ≥ 99.0%
Melting Point 70°C (heptahydrate dehydration); anhydrous: 1137°C
Decomposition 320°C (heptahydrate loses all water; anhydrous decomposes above 1100°C)
Molar Weight 120.37 g/mol (anhydrous); 246.47 g/mol (heptahydrate)
Particle Size Fine powder to coarse crystals
Key Uses
  • Corrects magnesium deficiency — vital for chlorophyll production
  • Used in foliar spray for greening and crop recovery
  • Medical applications: pre-eclampsia, constipation relief
  • Fixing agent in textile dyeing processes
Industries Served
Agriculture (magnesium & sulphur fertilizer)
Pharmaceutical (laxative, IV therapy)
Personal care & cosmetics (bath salts)
Textile & leather processing
Paper & pulp industry
Chemical synthesis
NaOH
Product Detail · Hydroxide Series

Caustic Soda

Sodium Hydroxide — one of the most widely used industrial chemicals in the world. Beryos supplies high-purity white flakes meeting the demands of chemical manufacturing, water treatment, textiles, and more.

Technical Specifications
Chemical Formula NaOH
Appearance White Flakes (Anhydrous)
Color White
Odour Odourless
pH (1% aqueous) 13.0 – 14.0
Solubility Highly Soluble in Water
Purity ≥ 99.0%
Melting Point 318°C (604°F)
Decomposition Above 1388°C
Molar Weight 40.00 g/mol
Physical Form Flakes / Prills / Pellets
Key Uses
  • Saponification — production of soap and detergents
  • pH adjustment and neutralisation in water treatment
  • Pulp digestion in paper and paper board manufacturing
  • Scouring and mercerising in textile processing
  • Alumina extraction from bauxite (Bayer process)
  • Chemical synthesis — intermediate for hundreds of compounds
Industries Served
Soap & Detergents Manufacturing
Water Treatment & Purification
Pulp & Paper Industry
Textile & Leather Processing
Chemical Synthesis & Pharmaceuticals
Food Processing (E524 grade)
KOH
Product Detail · Hydroxide Series

Caustic Potash

Potassium Hydroxide — a highly versatile strong base with superior solubility and reactivity compared to caustic soda. Essential for liquid soaps, biodiesel, specialty chemicals, and battery electrolytes.

Technical Specifications
Chemical Formula KOH
Appearance White Flakes (Anhydrous)
Color White
Odour Odourless
pH (1% aqueous) 13.0 – 14.0
Solubility Highly Soluble in Water
Purity ≥ 90.0% (as KOH)
Melting Point 360°C (680°F)
Decomposition Above 1327°C
Molar Weight 56.11 g/mol
Physical Form Flakes / Prills
Key Uses
  • Production of liquid soap, shampoo and soft soap bars
  • Transesterification in biodiesel manufacturing
  • Electrolyte in alkaline batteries and fuel cells
  • Potassium carbonate and potassium salt production
  • pH control in agricultural nutrient solutions
  • Chemical intermediate for pharmaceuticals and dyes
Industries Served
Soap & Liquid Detergent Manufacturing
Biodiesel & Renewable Energy
Battery & Energy Storage
Agriculture & Horticulture
Pharmaceutical & Chemical Synthesis
